videos.subtitle_summary:
The user wants me to summarize a YouTube video caption in Korean within approximately 500 characters. The video is about US tariffs on steel and Korean steel exports.
Key points from the caption:
1. US government partially eased high tariffs on steel, aluminum, and copper derivative products
2. Korean-made excavators, bulldozers, tractors, etc. tariff rate reduced from 25% to 15%
3. Applies to countries with separate tariff agreements with US (Korea, Japan, EU)
4. Export scale expected to be $2.3 billion
5. Agricultural equipment and HVAC equipment adjusted to 15% regardless of tariff agreement
6. US steel usage requirement for benefits lowered from 95% to 85%
7. Aluminum printing plates and steel racks newly added to 25% tariff list
8. Korean government had been requesting easing of Section 232 tariffs since last year's Korea-US tariff agreement
9. Tariffs not completely abolished, valid until end of next year
10. Research shows US 50% steel tariff could cause Korea GDP loss of about 3.2 trillion won
11. Steel industry urging government for follow-up measures like K-Steel Act enforcement ordinance
12. Gyeongbuk steel exports decreased 18% compared to 2020, China's low-price offensive plus US 50% tariff
13. UK also announced steel import quota reduction and tariff increase from July
